svg.title: Gibbs regions of the quadratic-map classes over F₉
svg.desc: Energy-entropy regions of the four non-degenerate fiber signatures. The dotted curve is the smallest dilation of the anisotropic region about the origin that contains the split region; its scale factor is the reciprocal of the exchange rate.
svg.text: An exchange rate as a dilation of energy–entropy regions
pure square x² (S) against split (X) over F₉ · the rate is the largest factor by which one region fits inside the other
contact at T = ∞: equal heights, log 9 = 1.3652 · log 5
